title: Full Body Core
description: TRX core circuit — five exercises, two rounds, 30s on / 30s off.
transcript:
TRX core circuit. Five exercises, two full rounds — thirty seconds on, thirty seconds off. About ten minutes. Brace your core on every movement.

TRX body saw, round one. Plank with feet in the straps. Rock forward and back — hips level, core tight. Anti-extension.

Feet in the straps, strong plank. Tuck both knees toward your chest, then extend back out — no sagging in the lower back.
